ts001.description: The professor's responsibilities include, but are not limited to, teaching a requisite number of graduate classes, assisting with the development of course
ts001.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/ts001) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) ## For Job code: TS001 #### **Professor** The professor’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to, teaching a requisite number of graduate classes, assisting with the development of course material, supervising postgraduate students, regularly publishing journal articles, serving on committees, attending conferences, writing proposals for grants, delivering presentations, and handling other administrative duties. | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **The Job:** | **–** | **Professor** | | **Education Qualifications for:** | – | **UG B.E Programs**
- Ph. D. degree in relevant field and First class or equivalent at either Bachelor’s or Master’s level in the relevant branch.
AND
- At least 6 research publications at the level of Associate Professor in SCI journals / UGC / AICTE approved list of journals and at least 2 successful Ph.D. guided as Supervisor / Cosupervisor till the date of eligibility of promotion.
OR
- At least 10 research publications at the level of Associate Professor in SCI journals / UGC / AICTE approved list of journals till the date of eligibility of promotion.
**Master of Computer Applications (MCA)**
- BE / B.Tech and ME / M.Tech in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent either in BE / B.Tech or ME / M.Tech with PhD
OR
- BE / B.Tech and MCA with First Class or equivalent in either BE / B.Tech or MCA with PhD
OR
- MCA With PhD Post PhD publications and guiding PhD students is highly desirable
**Master of Business Administration (MBA)**
- First Class or equivalent in Masters Degree in Business Administration or equivalent
And
- Post PhD publications and guiding PhD students is highly desirable | | **Experience required for:** | – | **UG B.E Programs**
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in teaching / research / industry out of which at least 3 years shall be at a post equivalent to that of an Associate Professor.
**Master of Computer Applications (MCA)**
- Minimum of 10 years teaching / research / industrial experience of which at least 5 years should be at the level of Associate Professor.
- OR
- Minimum of 13 years experience in teaching and/ or Research and/or Industry.
- In case of research experience, good academic record and books / research paper publications / IPR / patents record shall be required as deemed fit by the expert members of the Selection committee.
- If the experience in industry is considered, the same shall be at managerial level equivalent to Associate Professor with active participation record in devising / designing, planning, executing, analyzing, quality control, innovating, training, technical books / research paper publications / IPR / patents, etc. as deemed fit by the expert members of the Selection committee.
**Master of Business Administration (MBA)**
- Minimum of 10 years teaching / research / industrial experience of which at least 5 years should be at the level of Associate Professor.
OR
- Minimum of 10 years teaching / research / industrial experience of which at least 5 years should be at the level of Associate Professor.
OR
- Minimum of 13 years experience in teaching and/ or Research and/or Industry. In case of research experience, good academic record and books / research paper publications / IPR / patents record shall be required as deemed fit by the expert members of the Selection committee. If the experience in industry is considered, the same shall be at managerial level equivalent to Associate Professor with active participation record in devising / designing, planning, executing, analyzing, quality control, innovating, training, technical books / research paper publications / IPR / patents, etc. as deemed fit by the expert members of the Selection committee. | | **Location:** | – | Mysuru | | **Employment Type:** | – | Permanent | | **Roles and Responsibilities:** | – | **ACADEMIC** | | | | - Classroom Instruction, Laboratory Instruction And Curriculum Development
- Developing Learning Resource Material & Laboratory Development
- Students Assessment & Evaluation including Examination work of the University
- Participation in the Co-curricular & Extra-Curricular Activities
- Students Guidance & Counseling & helping their personal, ethical, moral and overall character development
- Continuing Education Activities
- Keeping abreast of new Knowledge and skills, help generate new knowledge and help dissemination of such knowledge through books, publications, etc.
- Self-development through upgrading qualification, experience & Professional activities.
**RESEARCH & CONSULTANCY**
- Research & Development Activities & Research Guidance
- Industry sponsored projects
- Providing Consultancy and Testing Services
- Promotion of Industry Institution interaction
**ADMINISTRATION**
- Academic and Administrative Management of the Institution
- Policy Planning, Monitoring & Evaluation and promotional activities both at Departmental and Institutional Level
- Design and Development of new Programmes
- Preparing project proposals for funding in areas of R&D work, Laboratory Development, Modernization, Expansion etc.
- Administration both at Departmental & Institutional level
- Development, Administration and management of Institutional facilities
- Participating in policy planning at the Regional, National level for development of Technical Education
- Helping mobilization of resources for the institution
- Plan and implement Staff Development activities
- Maintain Accountability
- Conduct performance Appraisal

- Participation in Community Services

- Providing non-formal modes of education for the benefit of the Community

adm003.description: Relevant experience: The candidate should have a minimum of 10-15 years of relevant experience in maintenance, operation, or management of engineering or
adm003.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/adm003) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) #### For Job code ADM003 | | | | --- | --- | | **The Job:** | **Resident Engineer- maintenance** | | **Education Qualification:** | The candidate should have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) in Civil Engineering from a recognized university or institute. | | **Experience:**
**Key Skills:** | **Relevant experience:** The candidate should have a minimum of 10-15 years of relevant experience in maintenance, operation, or management of engineering or technical facilities, such as building maintenance, utility management, equipment maintenance, or related fields.
**Experience in educational institutions:** Experience working in maintenance or facilities management roles in educational institutions, particularly in engineering colleges or technical institutes, may be preferred.
**Skill Sets**
**Technical knowledge:** Strong technical knowledge and expertise in the area of maintenance responsibility, such as civil systems, or other relevant systems. Knowledge of relevant codes, standards, and regulations related to maintenance and facility management. Well versed with preparation of estimates, drawing, billing, etc.
**Software Knowledge:** Autocad, MS office, Project Management tools.
**Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills:** Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, identify problems, and develop solutions to ensure proper functioning of facilities and equipment.
**Preventive maintenance:** Knowledge of preventive maintenance practices, scheduling, and implementation to proactively maintain facilities and equipment, and minimize downtime or disruptions.
**Project management:** Ability to manage maintenance projects, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
**Team management:** Leadership and interpersonal skills to effectively manage a maintenance team, coordinate with other departments, and work with contractors or vendors.
**Communication skills:** Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively communicate with staff, faculty, students, and other stakeholders regarding maintenance-related matters.
**Health and safety:** Knowledge of health and safety regulations and practices related to maintenance activities, and ensuring compliance with relevant guidelines and protocols. | | **Location:** | Mysuru | | **Employment Type:** | **Permanent** | | **Roles and Responsibilities:** | - Plan and execute maintenance work systematically by
- Preparing schedules for routine maintenance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
- Monitoring of work carried out as per plans through personal inspection and a sound feedback system.
- Taking corrective action to minimize the gap between plan and action.
- Submission of monthly status report on complaints.
- Continuously striving for an increase in the efficiency of maintenance staff by progressively mechanizing the work and reducing manual work.
- Trouble-shoot maintenance problems/complaints including plumbing problems.
- Trouble-shoot, diagnose and correct minor failures of water coolers, fans, pumps etc.
- To work in liaison and in co-ordination with outside maintenance contractors and technicians.
- Facilitate in the maintenance of the college grounds.
- Manage staff of maintenance technicians /semi-skilled, unskilled labour.
- Inspect the college properties for safety hazards and take corrective action.
- Co-ordinate the setting up of different areas/classrooms, Seminar Halls/Auditorium etc.
- Dealing with setup of various rooms, offices and assisting in removal and relocation of offices, rooms, and equipment.
- Upkeep of maintenance store.
- Any other function assigned by administrative officer/ Dean-Admin / Principal.
- Walk-through building spaces regularly to check for irregularities.
- Preparation of labour/sub-contractor/Contractors bills, Verification of Measurements & Rates.
- Ensuring timely payment to the vendors/Contractors
- Certifying the bills after ensuring the quality and on time completion
- To attend any other work that will be assigned by the higher authorities. | Social media & sharing icons powered by adm001.title: ADM001
adm001.description: Bachelor's degree: The candidate should have a bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field from a recognized university or
adm001.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/adm001) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) #### For Job code : ADM001 | | | | --- | --- | | **The Job:** | **Finance Officer** | | **Qualification** | **Education Qualification:**
**Bachelor’s degree:** The candidate should have a bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field from a recognized university or institute. A higher degree such as a master’s degree in finance, Accounting, or Business Administration may be preferred.
**Professional Certification:**
Professional certification such as Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or other relevant certifications may be preferred. | | **Experience:** | **Experience in financial management**: The candidate should have a minimum of 10-12 years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, budgeting, or finance-related roles, preferably in an educational institution or similar environment.
**Experience in higher education:** Experience working in finance or accounting roles in higher education institutions, particularly in engineering colleges or technical institutes, may be preferred.
**Skill Set Required**
**Financial management:** Strong knowledge of financial management principles, practices, and regulations, including budgeting, financial analysis, financial reporting, and auditing.
**Accounting and taxation:** Proficiency in accounting principles, practices, and software, as well as understanding of taxation laws and regulations relevant to educational institutions.
**Financial planning and forecasting:** Ability to develop and implement financial plans, budgets, and forecasts, and monitor financial performance against established targets.
**Compliance and regulatory knowledge:** Knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines related to finance and accounting in educational institutions, including those issued by statutory bodies or government agencies.
**Communication and leadership skills:** Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, as well as leadership skills to effectively manage a finance team, liaise with other departments, and communicate financial information to stakeholders.
**Analytical and problem-solving skills:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify financial issues, analyze data, and develop solutions to financial challenges. | | **Location:** | Mysuru | | **Employment Type:** | **Permanent** | | **Roles and Responsibilities:** | - Maintaining accounts, cash books / ledgers in the Accounting Software.
- Preparation of monthly accounts including cash books, journals
- Verifying bills prepared
- Preparation and consolidation of budgets pertaining to the Institute/ departments/ centres.
- Prepare office due, fee collection statement for submission to the Management.
- Prepare fund requirement statement for submission to the Management
- Coordinating with KEA/KUPECA/VTU and other statutory departments for collection of fee due to Institute.
- Coordinate with Statutory / Private authorities, Banks and organizations who grant Scholarship/Financial Aid to students for timely release of due fee amount.
- Supervision of Bank remittance, Reconciliation, etc.
- Preparation of daily receipts and challans and submission of associated details along with remittance details to Registrar/Principal for scrutiny.
- Verification of cheques and bills.
- Writing daily collection register for college accounts.
- Writing demand draft register, and other forms of money value register
- Preparation of audit reports and replies
- Responsible of keeping the following in safe custody:
- Bill books / receipt books
- Files pertaining to accounts/purchases
- Registers
- Cash books
- Ledgers
- Vouchers
- Cheque books / pass books
- Bank challans
- Fixed deposit certificates
- Other important office documents
- Processing of Salary in A-IMS and arranging for Bank Transfers.
- Receiving of Cash, DD’s and / Reports generated in A-IMS from Exam Section, Fee Section and other departments on daily basis and make necessary arrangements for depositing the same to Bank.
- Download the Collection Report from A-IMS on daily basis and check whether the duly signed hard copy is received from concern person and then update the transactions in Tally.
- Making Statutory Payments like PF, ESI, PT, IT, etc., after due verification.
- Preparation of acquaintance register and obtaining signatures of all employees.
- Attending to the subject of income tax, and performing TDS at source for all payment transactions.
- Writing Caution deposit register, if any
- Any other accounts related function assigned from time to time. | Social media & sharing icons powered by nts003.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/nts003) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) #### For Job code NTS003 | | | | --- | --- | | **The Job:** | **Resident Hostel Supervisors** | | **Education Qualification:** | **Bachelor’s degree:** The candidate should have a Bachelor’s degree in any field from a recognized university or institute. A degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, or a related field may be preferred. | | **Experience:** | **Minimum 4-6 years Relevant experience:** The candidate should have relevant experience in managing hostels or residential facilities, preferably in an educational institution or similar environment.
**Supervisory experience:** Experience in supervising or managing staff, overseeing operations, and ensuring compliance with policies and regulations related to hostels or residential facilities.
**Customer service experience:** Experience in providing customer service, addressing student needs and concerns, and maintaining a positive and inclusive living environment in a hostel or residential facility.
**Skillsets:**
**Hostel management:** Strong knowledge of hostel management principles, practices, and regulations, including student admissions, room allotment, facility maintenance, security, and other related functions.
**Student engagement:** Ability to engage with students, understand their needs, and provide support in a residential setting, including managing student activities, programs, and events.
**Communication skills:** Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively communicate with students, staff, faculty, and other stakeholders regarding hostel-related matters.
**Conflict resolution:** Ability to handle and resolve conflicts, complaints, or disciplinary issues in a fair and effective manner, while maintaining a positive and inclusive living environment for students.
**Team management:** Leadership and interpersonal skills to effectively manage hostel staff, coordinate with other departments, and work with students from diverse backgrounds.
**Health and safety:** Knowledge of health and safety regulations and practices related to hostels or residential facilities, and ensuring compliance with relevant guidelines and protocols.
**Problem-solving skills:** Ability to identify and address operational or logistical issues related to hostel management, and develop solutions to ensure smooth and efficient operations. | | **Location:** | Mysuru | | **Employment Type:** | **Permanent** | | **Roles and Responsibilities:** | - The Resident Hostel Supervisor shall obtain approval from the Chief Warden / Deputy Warden for allocating rooms to students and issuing furniture/electrical items for placement/installation in the rooms.
- All applications from students regarding hostel matters shall be forwarded to the Warden.
- Coordinate with the Electrical maintenance section, building section, and sanitary department to ensure proper maintenance of hostel rooms, common rooms, toilets, mess, and premises. Maintain records and recover hostel dues.
- Ensure proper water supply and drinking water arrangements in the hostel.
- Maintain the Hostel stock register.
- Report to the Warden regarding students who violate mess rules and default on clearing mess dues.
- Keep a record of students’ leave (monitor the In and Out register).
- Supervise the work of hostel support staff and security guards.
- Maintain attendance registers.
- Arrange for students to visit the library during night hours.
- Regularly visit students’ rooms to address their day-to-day problems.
- Provide advice and guidance for the smooth operation of the mess, including displaying the weekly menu and maintaining food quality.
- Take appropriate action on complaints recorded in the complaint register.
- Maintain a leave register for workers and forward their leave applications to the honorary warden.
- Arrange for medical assistance, including doctor/ambulance, for students in case of medical emergencies.
- Arrange transportation for students to the airport/railway station during late-night hours.
- Provide daily reports to the Warden regarding maintenance of civil and electrical works, student discipline, guest/visitor records, and any other noteworthy information. Consolidated reports should be emailed to the Chief Warden / Deputy Warden on a daily basis.
- Ensure that security guards and mess supervisors perform the following tasks as part of their duties | Social media & sharing icons powered by [Skip to content](/p/nts002) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) #### **For Job code NTS002** | | | | --- | --- | | **The Job:** | **Instructor & Assistant Instructors** | | **Education:** | Diploma /B. Tech in relevant branch with 1st class | | **Experience:** | 2-3 years | | **Location:** | Mysuru | | **Employment Type:** | **Permanent** | | **Roles and Responsibilities:** | - Make a list of components & equipment for the upcoming lab in consultation with faculty in charge of lab, Foreman & HOD.
- Arrange for demonstration of new equipment purchase if any, in consultation with Foreman and faculty in-charge.
- Check the quality of equipment and certify, after purchase of equipment
- Identify weak students by the end of the first month and report the list to faculty in-charge.
- Schedule additional classes for the weak students in consultation with Foreman and faculty in-charge.
- Monitor the progress of the students and ensure students reach the required level of competency before the end of second month.
- Help the students in the implementation of mini projects & Projects.
- Assist the faculty in the preparation of the lab manual.
- Test the lab experiments one month before the commencement of the semester.
- Providing guidance & assistance to students to do mini projects & projects.
- Design & develop required material for the smooth conduction of the lab.
- Upload the lab videos two weeks before the commencement of the semester.
- Coordinating with Internship program.
- Assisting faculty in preparing the content for virtual lab
- Assist the faculty with the assigned work.
- Maintain the logbook.
- Maintain the stock register.
- Check the working of equipment within 15 days after the last working day and get the servicing done if required either in-house or from an external agency.
- Get the calibration of equipment done within 15days after the last working day of the semester.
- Prepare charts/ boards required for the upcoming labs within three weeks after the last working day.
- Display the lab timetable, list of students, list of experiments, and lab cycle in the notice board.
- Assist foreman to prepare documents during the examination.
- Coordinate and provide support in Department & Institution related activities
- Assist, coordinate & provide support in Department & institutional related events.
- Taking active participation in providing assistance to the administrators of the Institution
- Assisting faculty in writing proposals for funding. | Social media & sharing icons powered by why-atme.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/why-atme)

## Why ATME...?!

- Futuristic infrastructure with modern facilities.
- Highly qualified, experienced and dedicated faculty members.
- Prestigious accreditations from **NBA, NAAC “A+” grade, and Gold Ranking by QS-i Gauge.**
- Strong collaborations with leading industries for real-world exposure
- Career counselling and guidance programs for personalized career development.
- Encouragement of research and innovation among students and faculty.
- Wide range of extracurricular activities for all-round development.
- Dedicated placement cell for comprehensive career support.
- Current-day environment for professional development to global standards.
- Pervasive culture of excellence.
- Numerous Sports achievements.
- Certification Courses from renowned industries for skill development.
- Digital Classrooms for effective learning.
- Promoted by the best names in education, technology and social service.

atme-online-payments.description: This online payment system is provided by ATME College of Engineering. ATME College of Engineering may update these terms from time to time and any changes
atme-online-payments.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/atme-online-payments)

[![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/)

## Online Payments

This online payment system is provided by ATME College of Engineering. ATME College of Engineering may update these terms from time to time and any changes will be effective immediately on being set out here. Please ensure you are aware of the current terms. The country of domicile for ATME College of Engineering is India.

### Instructions to pay online fees

#### Video Player      [https://atme.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Online-Fee-Payment-Demo-Video-1-1.mp4](https://atme.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Online-Fee-Payment-Demo-Video-1-1.mp4)                        Media error: Format(s) not supported or source(s) not found  [Download File: https://atme.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Online-Fee-Payment-Demo-Video-1-1.mp4?\_=1](https://atme.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Online-Fee-Payment-Demo-Video-1-1.mp4?_=1)                        00:00    00:00    00:00    Use Up/Down Arrow keys to increase or decrease volume.

#### [Click here to Download Instructions for Online Fees Payments](/__l5e/assets-v1/690daad6-2466-4aa9-8d9c-b66e2621a14d/ATMECE_Online-Fees-Payment-Process.pdf)

[Make Online Payement](http://aims.atme.edu.in/portal/ "")

#### [Terms & Conditions](/p/atme-online-payments)

Please read these terms carefully before using the online payment facility. Using the online payment facility on this website indicates that you accept these terms. If you do not accept these terms do not use this facility.

**All payments are subject to the following conditions: –**

The description of services of match making are specific to your need, when you log in with your unique password. Normally payment is required in advance (i.e. before you commence your activity).

All Fees quoted are in Indian Rupees. The  ATME College of Engineering reserves the right to change the fees at any time.

- Your payment will normally reach the ATME College of Engineering account to which you are making a payment within two working days.
- We cannot accept liability for a payment not reaching the correct ATME College of Engineering account due to you quoting an incorrect account number or incorrect personal details. Neither can we accept liability if payment is refused or declined by the credit/debit card supplier for any reason.
- If the card supplier declines payment the ATME College of Engineering is under no obligation to bring this fact to your attention. You should check with your bank/credit/debit card supplier that payment has been deducted from your account.
- In no event will the ATME College of Engineering be liable for any damages whatsoever arising out of the use, inability to use, or the results of use of this site, any websites linked to this site, or the materials or information contained at any or all such sites, whether based on warranty, contract, tort or any other legal theory and whether or not advised of the possibility of such damages.

**Applicable Terms and Conditions**

1. Any type of fee payment i.e., College Fee, Exam Fee, study certificate, any event fee, etc., should be made only through logging into A-IMS.
2. Students shall not pay to any staff or any other person who claims as representative of college either through cash or any other mode.
3. We are withdrawing all other modes like direct cash deposit to our College Account, making payment by scanning the QR Code, direct NEFT, or any other kind.
4. Hence making payment by any other mode will not be considered as fee payment and the amount will not be refunded.
5. While making online payment if the transaction is not successful, minimum waiting time would be at least 15 minutes. A student should wait for 15 minutes before trying to make another payment and also check the status. Refunds will not be given if this is ignored and double payments are made.
6. Students should approach the Fee Section once payment is made and Receipt is reflected in their login. Fee section will issue the Receipt duly signed and it should also include the College seal. Only this receipt is valid.
7. In case of any discrepancies in the fee due reflecting in A-IMS one should approach the Fee Section.
8. In case of further clarifications, they can always approach their HOD / Department A-IMS Coordinators / Mr. Kiran B Asst. Professor CSE / Ms. Amrutha Kashyap AAO.

#### [Refund Policy](/p/atme-online-payments)

- If the Customer leaves the ATME College of Engineering before they complete their service period, there shall be no entitlement to a refund of paid service fees.
- Refunds, if applicable, at the discretion of the Management, will only be made to the debit/credit card used for the original transaction. For the avoidance of doubt nothing in this Policy shall require the ATME College of Engineering to refund the Fees (or part thereof) unless such Fees (or part thereof) have previously been paid.

#### [Privacy Policy](/p/atme-online-payments)

This Privacy Policy applies to all of the products, services and websites offered by ATME College of Engineering. Sometimes, we may post product specific privacy notices or Help Centre materials to explain our products in more detail.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please feel free to contact us through our website or write to us at

Information we collect and how we use it for our ATME College of Engineering.

#### [Changes to our Privacy Policy](/p/atme-online-payments)

ATME College of Engineering reserves the entire right to modify/amend/remove this privacy statement anytime and without any reason. Nothing contained herein creates or is intended to create a contract/agreement between ATME College of Engineering and any user visiting the ATME College of Engineering website or providing identifying information of any kind.

#### [DND Policy](/p/atme-online-payments)

If you wish to stop any further SMS/email alerts/contacts from our side, all you need to do is to send an email with your mobile numbers and you will be excluded from the alerts list.

#### [Contact Details](/p/atme-online-payments)

Email:[enquiry@atme.edu.in](mailto:enquiry@atme.edu.in)

clubs-associations.title: Clubs & Associations
clubs-associations.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/clubs-associations) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) ## Clubs & Associations **CIVIL ENGINEERING ASSOCIATIONS (CEA)** #### [CIVIL ENGINEERING ASSOCIATIONS (CEA)](/p/clubs-associations) ### **About CEA** Civil Engineering Association was shaped with the number one objective of revealing budding civilians of ATME to the challenges of career. The Association promotes the competencies of college students in co-curricular and extracurricular sports and maintains students and group of workers privy to the present day traits and to function as efficient participants of the profession and society with information of worldwide ramification of work. The Students of Civil Engineering Department constitute its participants. Providing guidance and training to students to develop better learning skills and personality. #### [INNOVATION CLUB](/p/clubs-associations) ‘Innovation club’ was inaugurated by Dr. R. Balasubramainiam of SVYM ( [Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement](https://www.google.co.in/url?sa=t&rct=j&q=&esrc=s&source=web&cd=1&cad=rja&uact=8&ved=0ahUKEwiilOPEiunPAhUEuY8KHboyDHAQFggdMAA&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.svym.org%2F&usg=AFQjCNFXzupc7Xn_oKkkDYOLkb3RBf4qsQ) ) on 20th Oct 2016. Speaking on the occasion to gathering Dr. R. Balasubramainiam emphasized about the importance of innovation to students at large and society in particular. He asked students to imbibe innovative mindset to be relevant in this globalized and competitive world. ![](/__l5e/assets-v1/a5010d6b-8bdd-4e97-a201-35bd1227ceb1/Innovation-Club-01.jpg) **Objectives** 1. To support and carry out mini and innovative projects. 2. To conduct technical activities for students. **Events Conducted** **Mini project on Footstep Power Generator** Sharon Markus and  Prashanth N S did a mini project on “Mini project on Footstep Power Generator”, which was demonstrated in the inter collegiate project exhibition. It was recognised as best hobby project in the event. **Mini project on Battery Operated Duster Cleaner** Sharon Markus and  Prashanth N S did a mini project on “Mini project on Bateery Operated Duster Cleaner”, which was demonstrated in the inter collegiate project exhibition. It was recognised as best hobby project in the event. ## Entrepreneurship Development cell

Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC) is an integral part of the ATME College of Engineering. The cell was established to promote and foster entrepreneurship among the students of the college. The main objective of the EDC is to create a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship, and to provide a platform for students to develop their entrepreneurial skills.

The EDC at ATME College of Engineering conducts various activities to encourage and support entrepreneurship. It organizes workshops, seminars, guest lectures, and training programs on various aspects of entrepreneurship such as ideation, business planning, marketing, finance, and legal issues. These events are aimed at providing students with the necessary knowledge and skills required to start and run a successful business.

In addition to these activities, the EDC also conducts various entrepreneurship competitions and challenges to encourage students to showcase their innovative ideas and entrepreneurial skills. These competitions provide a platform for students to interact with other aspiring entrepreneurs and gain exposure to the startup ecosystem.

The EDC also provides mentorship and guidance to aspiring entrepreneurs. It connects students with experienced entrepreneurs, investors, and industry experts who can provide valuable insights and guidance on various aspects of business development. The EDC also provides access to funding opportunities and incubation support to promising startups.

The EDC at ATME College of Engineering has been successful in fostering a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among its students. Many successful startups have emerged from the EDC, and several students have gone on to become successful entrepreneurs. The EDC continues to play a vital role in shaping the entrepreneurial landscape of the region and has become a model for other institutions to emulate.

Entrepreneurship Development Cell at ATME College of Engineering is a great initiative that has been successful in promoting and fostering entrepreneurship among students. The cell’s various activities and initiatives have helped students to develop their entrepreneurial skills and to start successful businesses. The EDC continues to play a vital role in shaping the entrepreneurial landscape of the region and is an excellent example of how institutions can support and encourage entrepreneurship among students.

[Skip to content](/p/ai-ml/ai-ml-hods-message)

[![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/)

## HOD's Message

![](/__l5e/assets-v1/6258ee69-0c35-4487-85cc-f44840ed5d86/jvg.jpg)The Department of AIML at ATMECE is dedicated to impart constructive and quality technical education with high standards at undergraduate level. The faculty members of the department are committed to make our students by providing the expertise and proficiency in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to tackle the issues of societies.

**Dr. J V Gorabal**

Department is well equipped with all modern computing facilities to meet the academic and industrial requirements.

AIML can be used to create computer programs that mimic human conversation. AIML can also be used to create virtual assistants, which are computer programs that can perform tasks such as scheduling appointments and sending emails. Additionally, AIML can be used to create educational software, which can be used to teach people about topics such as history or science.

The objective of the program is to provide an experiential learning opportunities such as hands-on experience and project-based learning, indulge in research projects, and internships which provide a strong foundation to work across the globe.

We at ATMECE more prominence is placed on elevating the students learning experience by providing value-added courses, skill-enhancement programs, and motivate students to participate in technical symposiums, hackathons organised by premier institutes across the nation.

The students, faculty, and staff of AIML at ATMECE, we believe in teamwork, we inspire, encourage each other, we help each other, and, most importantly, we trust each other. This is the key to make our students success at AIML program at ATMECE. To bring the success and laurels to the department we focus more on constructive engagements which will enable employment opportunities to our students.

I am confident that the Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at ATMECE is stalwartly prepared to face the new societal issues and challenges in this new IT era with Indian Talent (IT). We hope and assure that we transform our students in all dimensions of their life to become better citizen of this nation for better India and better world.

– **Dr. J V Gorabal**

[![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/)

## Library Rules & Regulation

- Users are required to enter their USN/Member ID and sign the register provided at the entrance.
- Wearing coats, jackets, sweaters, caps, hats are not allowed inside the stack and reference area. The Library staff reserve the right to inspect any person who appears suspicious.
- Users are advised not to leave their valuable items such as wallet, laptops, debit/credit card, bags, cases, folders etc., at the property counter. Library is not responsible for any loss of individual’s aforesaid properties.
- Personal belongings including baggage and personal textbooks will not be allowed inside the stack and reference area except loose sheets and notebook.
- Reading materials including notebooks, personal textbooks will be allowed inside the general reading room only.
- Students’ Institute Identity Card is necessary for access to the library and information Centre.
- The users shall maintain silence within the library premises. Conversations, gossip are strictly forbidden. No reader is allowed to sleep in the premises.
- Library authority upholds the right to recall any issued book even before the due date.
- Anyone caught marking, defacing or mutilating books or any other library material is accountable to replace the same.
- The membership of the library is not transferable.
- Users are not allowed to reshelf books or journals after removing them from the shelf. Leave them on the table or on the nearby trolley.
- Eatables are not allowed inside the Library.
- The Book must be returned on or before the due date. After the due date Rs. 1/ day will be charged.

**Loss of Books**

When an item is lost or damaged, the borrower will be charged for the item as follows.

- The member has to procure a new edition copy of the same overdue fines if any. **Or**
- A sum of two times the estimated cost of an item will be charged for loss of book / item.

**ISSUE OF NO DUE CERTIFICATE**

Library No-Due certificate will be issued to the users after the return of borrowed library resource materials.

**Dr. M.S. GOVINDE GOWDA**

**Education Details:**

- Ph. D – Thermal and Fluids Engineering.
- MTech – Thermal and Fluids Engineering.
- B.E – Mechanical Engineering.

**Professional Experience**

- 34 Years.

#### [Publication Details](/p/dr-govindegowda-m-s)

- 17 International Journal Papers.

- Heat and Mass Transfer

#### [Roles and Responsibility](/p/dr-govindegowda-m-s)

**Roles and Responsibility**

- Dean (Academics) and Professor

**Professional body membership**

- ISTE, Life member.
- Fellow of IEI

**Achievements:**

**@ University Level**

- Presently serving as “Academic Senate Member, VTU” and “Chairman, BOS, Mechanical (Composite) Board, VTU” for the period of 2022-2025.
- Currently serving as “Academic Council Member” as a representative of Hon’ble VC of VTU to BITM-Ballari for the period of 2021-2024 for autonomous system.
- Served as Chairman, BOE, Mechanical (Composite) Board, VTU for the year 2021-22.
- Served as “Academic Senate Member, VTU” from June 2019 to June 2022.
- Serving/Served as Chairman, Local Inquiry Committee (LIC) of VTU.
- Local Inquiry Committee (LIC) member of VTU.
- Served as BOE member for Mechanical Engg. board of VTU for the year 2010-11
- Served as BOS member in Mechanical board for Ph.D Registration Committee for Ph.D /M.Sc(Engg.) by research of VTU.
- Served as ‘Chairman, BOE, Aeronautical Engg. (Composite) Board’, VTU during 2016-17.
- Served as ‘Member, BOE, Mechanical Engg. (Composite) Board’, VTU for AY 2017-18.
- Governing Council Member, VTU Nominee to Shashib Engg. College, Bangalore, for the period 2014-2016.
- Governing Council Member, VTU Nominee to SJMIT, Chitradurga for the period 2017-2019.
- Governing Council Member, VTU Nominee to VVIET, Mysore, for the period 2019-2021.

#### [FDP/Conferences/Workshops attended/Conducted](/p/dr-govindegowda-m-s)

**FDP/Conferences/Workshops attended/Conducted**

- FDPs/Workshops/Technical Talks have been conducting/organising to train the faculty on NBA and NAAC process.
- Awareness programs are being conducted for the implementation of NEP in HEIs.
- Attended more than 20 Workshop/Seminars.
- FDP programs are also conducted especially for fresh teachers under “Teachers Induction Training Programs” to explore them on effective class room teaching.
- “Faculty Enrichment Programes” have been conducted to assure the quality of teaching by the faculty members in the Teaching-Learning Processseveral guest lectures at various institutions.
- Delivered lectures on “Turbo Machines” through Live Telecast of VTU-Edusatprogramme-15 during 2011.
- Participated as Resource Person for “Carrier Counselling-2014” organized by The Hindu Education Plus on 31-5-2014 at Dr.TTIT, KGF.
- Delivered motivational talk on “Towards excellence…..” for teachers at various Engineering colleges.
- Invited talk on “Turbo Machines” at various colleges under FDP programs.
- Training and motivating the faculty in making them excellent and confident in academic contents delivery under “Faculty Recharge Program”.

remote-center-of-iit-bombay.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/remote-center-of-iit-bombay) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) ## ATME College of Engineering, has been recognized as Remote center of IIT Bombay Adding yet another feather in its step, The ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru, has been recognized as Remote Center of Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay (IIT-B) on 23rd  May 2019 ( Remote Center Code: 1563). As IIT-B’s Remote Center, ATME will host the faculty members to attend live online courses/workshops delivered by IIT Bombay’s members. The participating faculty members would be attending lectures, tutorials, lab sessions and live interactions with the IIT-B faculty through distance mode using internet and advanced A-VIEW technology. The Teaching Learning  Centre (ICT) is organising workshops at IIT Bombay, a scheme of ‘Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya National Mission on Teachers and Teaching’ (PMMMNMTT), an initiative of the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India. **Methodology** Under the programme, IIT Bombay conducts ISTE workshops during the vacation period in summer and winter. Teachers attend the workshops at a designated Remote Center (RC), close to their own college. Lectures are delivered by faculty from IIT Bombay, while tutorials and lab sessions are conducted locally in the same RC. The lecture transmission and live interaction take place in a virtual classroom environment, using the AVIEW technology on the internet. Faculty coordinators are appointed at each remote centre, to handle the technology infrastructure and other operational logistics. Additionally, for each workshop, there is a workshop faculty coordinator for that subject who will help in the conduct of labs and tutorials at that center. We invite expert faculty from various remote centers to a five-day Coordinators training workshop which is held in IIT Bombay, at least two months before the main workshop. These Coordinators then act as Workshop Coordinators during the main workshop, liaising between the participants at their Remote Centers and IIT Bombay from where the workshop is transmitted live. During the main workshop, the Workshop Coordinator at every center supervises the conduct of tutorials and Labs. All the lectures and tutorial sessions are recorded. The final edited audio-visual contents, along with other course material are released under Open Source. ## Green Campus

ATME campus is designed eco-friendly and landscaped with extensive gardens, Plantation with recycled water. The entire campus is maintained as non-smoking zone. The significant initiatives implemented are:

#### [ENERGY CONSERVATION](/p/green-campus)

- 90% LED and 10% CFL Lamp bulbs provided within the campuses. In a phased manner all CFL lights will be replaced by LED.
- Staggering of electric power loads to reduce maximum demands.
- All the Fans, Lights and Air conditioners are maintained in the switched off mode when not in use. The slogans insisting the necessity to switch off the Fans, Lights & ACs displayed above to all the switch boards in the campus.

#### [USE OF RENEWABLE ENERGY SOURCES](/p/green-campus)

100 kW solar power plants has been setup on the top of the Administrative block building. To that extent EB consumption has been reduced and hence non-renewable energy consumption to generate 100 kW is reduced and also CO2, SO2, SPM emissions reduction have been achieved. The output of the plant is converted to AC using 3 string inverters. The inverters have a MPPT controller and the inverters itself have the mechanism to synchronizes the generated power to the local grid. It is estimated that it will generates around 430 Units per day.

Moreover, many solar energy related student projects have been undertaken in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering programmes.

#### [WATER HARVESTING](/p/green-campus)

Recharging of ground water and rain water collection and utilization are implemented in the College. Rain Water Harvesting System is installed to collect rain water from roof top of the buildings and allow it to flow into sump of one lakh liter capacity behind Electrical Engineering Block. Efficient filter system has been installed and this water is pumped to overhead tank and reused. Rain water from the roof top of Administrative building is taken to scientifically planned series of ground water recharging pits to augment the ground water level.

#### [SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT](/p/green-campus)

The solid waste is segregated by providing separate dustbins for bio-degradable and plastic waste. Metal waste from the workshop are stored and given to authorized scrap agents for further processing.

#### [SEWAGE TREATMENT PLANT](/p/green-campus)

All the septic tank waste water collected to the Sewage Treatment Plant with the processing capacity of 1,00,000 litre per day and storage capacity of 1,00,000 litre, aeration tank, settling tank, clarifier with 3,00,000 litre capacity, filtered water used for gardening.

#### [E-WASTE MANAGEMENT](/p/green-campus)

E-waste or Electronic waste describes discarded electrical or electronic devices. E-waste typically includes discarded computer monitors, motherboards, Cathode Ray tubes (CRT), Printed Circuit Board (PCB), mobile phones and chargers, compact discs, headphones, white goods such as Liquid Crystal Displays (LCD)/ Plasma televisions, air conditioners, refrigerators and so on. Following are some of the measures adopted in college with regard to E-waste management.

- **Re-evaluate.** Try to avoid an extra gadget with finding one device with multiple functions.
- **Extend the life of your electronics.** Keeping the device well maintained will extend the life thereby avoiding procurement of new one.
- **Buy environmentally friendly electronics.** Look for products labelled Energy Efficient labelled by Bureau of Energy Efficient.
- **Donate used electronics to social programs**—outdated and obsolete computer or any other electronic gadget are donated to social programs.
- **E- Bins**: To manage e-waste, e-bin is installed which will be collected by KSPCB authorized e-waste recycler or e-waste disposer.

#### [ENVIRONMENT AWARENESS TO STUDENTS & PUBLIC](/p/green-campus)

Campus cleaning day is followed periodically with about 1800 students participating as part of awareness creation both within the campus and nearby villages.Campus cleaning day is followed periodically with about 1800 students participating as part of awareness creation both within the campus and nearby villages.

#### [NO SMOKING ZONE](/p/green-campus)

The entire campus is maintained as non-smoking zone

## Campus WIFI

Campus-wide Wi-Fi enables students and faculty members to connect with the College portal and Internet at any time and any place.

ATME is having an enterprise-class IT Infrastructure to support Students, faculty members, and Management. Our state-of-the-art computing and communication resources provide 24×7 facilities such as Campus ERP, Students and Faculty portal, Internet surfing, Web & Desktop applications, Virtual labs, E-Library, NPTL Videos, KOHA, D Space, E-Mail, Projects, Seminars, and Interactive Tele-lectures many more applications.

High-speed network with OFC across the campus provides seamless connectivity to the Internet for students and faculty members over an ample bandwidth.

All the data on the ATME network is strictly monitored and filtered to comply with Institute’s IT and Data security policies.

**Wi-Fi Access points in Campus- 18 No’s**

atme-trust.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/atme-trust)

[![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/)

## ATME Trust

Academy for Technical & Management Excellence, a Registered Charitable Trust was founded by Mr. Arun Kumar L and a group of like – minded technocrats, academicians, administrators and policymakers in 2007. The charitable trust was formed to bring in a new and younger generation of entrepreneurs, industry-ready professionals for the global society of tomorrow with a focus on cultural values, social responsibility and community service. Founders are having rich experience of managing various kind of enterprises like infrastructure companies, IT companies, Manufacturing units and other walks of life. Founders are aware of the need of the growing engineering and management industry and trying to cater to such needs by building institutes of eminence.

**Objectives**

- To empower the younger generation with quality education and groom top-notch professionals, entrepreneurs and leaders for different fields of engineering, technology and management.
- To promote basic & applied research in areas of social relevance, and share the knowledge for the advancement of mankind.
- To develop academic, professional and financial alliances with the industry as well as the academia at national and international levels.
- To cultivate strong community relationships and involve the younger generation in local community service.
- To constantly enhance the value of the educational inputs with the participation of students, faculty, parents and industry.

**Vision** **of the Trust**

To create future leaders of international standards who are competent, innovative, ethical and focused towards the betterment of the society and the country at large.

**Mission** **of the Trust**

- To create institutes of eminence to contribute in acquiring and enhancing knowledge that helps in the advancement of humankind.
- Generating new knowledge through research and disseminating such knowledge for the nation’s wealth creation and social welfare.
- To collaborate with industry, government & professional bodies and establish a stimulating learning environment.
- To encourage entrepreneurship through education and economic benefits.

## Mr. Arun Kumar L - Chairman

![](/__l5e/assets-v1/40be962a-0395-46ef-a8e1-76bf7bb03d77/chairmans-message.jpg)

A Civil engineering Graduate from the University of Mysuru with 30 years of experience in managing different verticals of infrastructure providing company. He has been in conceptualizing, Strategies, Business Tie-ups and upscaling activities of infrastructure development. His dynamism and capability are best understood from his achievements with accomplishments. His extraordinary entrepreneurial skills has helped the organization to manage the explosive growth. His foresight facilitated the company in diversifying its activities.

## Mr. K. Shivashankar - Secretary

![](/__l5e/assets-v1/e36d262a-b990-46a5-a481-38d8adfb4bd3/shivashankar.jpg)

A Civil Engineering Graduate from the University of Mysuru with 32 years of experience in Liaisoning, legal and Business Development. His expertise in liaisoning with government agencies, familiarities with legalities, statutory provisions and rapport is instrumental in achieving goals in the limited time frame.

## Mr. R. Veeresh - Treasurer

![](/__l5e/assets-v1/92918fce-a0ba-4e56-b583-eb4a76a03cb9/veeresh.jpg)

A Civil Engineering Graduate from the University of Mysuru with 30 years of experience in project executions. With his innovations and updated technologies, he is at the helm of affair in the implementation of Infrastructure Projects. With his expertise and knowledge, he has induced confidence to execute projects of any volume and complexity to maximal standards of quality and customer satisfaction.

## Mr. H. Venkatesh - Trustee

![](/images/uploads/2022/05/venkatesh.jpg)

A Civil Engineering Graduate from the University of Mysuru with 30 years of experience in various infrastructure projects. He has predominantly executed many electrical projects involving H.T & L.T Lines, Setting up of distribution transformer centers of rating 15 KVA to 500KVA, Setting up of Sub-Stations, Construction of transmission tower & lines varying from 33 KVA to 220 KVA.

## Mr. Dhirendra Kumar R Mehta - Trustee

![](/images/uploads/2022/05/Mr.-Dhirendra-Kumar-R-Mehta.png)

Former visiting Lecturer at Sharada Vilas Law college for 7 years Passed Intermediate Chartered Accountancy Member of Bar Council of Karnataka, Rotary Mysuru, Bar Council of Mysuru. Trustee of Srividya Trust.

## Prof. K. R. Mallikarjunappa - Trustee

![](/images/uploads/2022/05/Prof.-K.R.-Mallikarjunappa.png)

Ex-Member of Legislative Council \| Retired Professor in Economics \| Vice President – MUPCTA \| President – JSS Housing Society, Mysuru \| Secretary – Karnataka Economic Association \| Board of Studies, University Enquiry Commission, Senate, Academic Council.

## Mrs. Nooreain - Trustee

![](/images/uploads/2022/05/noorien-shakeeb.jpg)

Member of Gem Educational Society, Naunehall Educational Society \| Inner Wheel – Rotary Mid Town (Former Treasurer).

## Seminar & Auditorium

The ATME College of Engineering has developed a state-of-the-art campus with the latest and most modern educational facilities. In line with this, have an Auditorium equipped with a superior audio video system with Video conferencing facility which is auto controlled without human interference logically controlled and modulate the music and input source.

Highlighting features of Auditorium:

- Complete soundproof acoustic with aesthetic woodwork
- 400 plus Seating capacity with Foldable Writing pads
- Superior audio video system with Video conferencing facility
- Hall air conditioned capacity- 60 tons Ducted AC units

ATME College of Engineering has provided Seminar Halls for each department in order to facilitate departments to conduct activities suck workshops, Exhibitions or any other co-curricular activities both in house and Inter-Collegiate level in order to motivate students. Seminar Halls in each department has seating capacity of about 200 No’s and also projectors are provided in each Seminar Hall.

3rd Year, ECE

Quality of teaching is good, the faculty are reputed and understanding. The curriculum is in par with the latest trends in education and the faculties are constantly improving with the ever-evolving educational practices. One can always get their problems solved without any hesitation. They are the Spark that makes me study and ready for job placements.

![](https://atme.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Chingakham-Romita-Chanu-1-92x92.jpg)

### Chingakham Romita Chanu

4th Year, ECE

The teachers are great, enthusiastic and caring. The teachers make sure the students understand the topics by taking the example of real-world applications so the classes are interactive. They are concerned about students' careers and always take time and go out of the way  even under busy schedules for students who need them.

## Department of CSE – Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

#### **About the Department**

The Department of AIML at ATMECE is dedicated to impart constructive and quality technical education with high standards at undergraduate level. The faculty members of the department are committed to make our students by providing the expertise and proficiency in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to tackle the issues of societies. Department is well equipped with all modern computing facilities to meet the academic and industrial requirements. AIML can be used to create computer programs that mimic human conversation. AIML can also be used to create virtual assistants, which are computer programs that can perform tasks such as scheduling appointments and sending emails. Additionally, AIML can be used to create educational software, which can be used to teach people about topics such as history or science.

The objective of the program is to provide an experiential learning opportunities such as hands-on experience and project-based learning, indulge in research projects, and internships which provide a strong foundation to work across the globe.

We at ATMECE more prominence is placed on elevating the students learning experience by providing value-added courses, skill-enhancement programs, and motivate students to participate in technical symposiums, hackathons organized by premier institutes across the nation. The students, faculty, and staff of AIML at ATMECE, we believe in teamwork, we inspire, encourage each other, we help each other, and, most importantly, we trust each other. This is the key to make our students success at AIML program at ATMECE. To bring the success and laurels to the department we focus more on constructive engagements which will enable employment opportunities to our students.

I am confident that the Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at ATMECE is stalwartly prepared to face the new societal issues and challenges in this new IT era with Indian Talent (IT). We hope and assure that we transform our students in all dimensions of their student life to become better citizen of this nation for better India and better world.

**![](/__l5e/assets-v1/8d7535a0-6aa0-49ec-b2d1-bf695d4d2869/Mr.-Anil-Kumar-C-J.jpg)**

**Dr. Anil Kumar C J**

**Professor & Head CSE(AIML)**

#### [Vision of the Department](/p/ai-ml)

To impart technical education in the field of Artificial intelligence and machine learning of topnotch quality with a high level of professional competence, social obligation, and global cognizance among the students.

#### [Mission of the Department](/p/ai-ml)

- To impart technical education that is up to date, relevant and makes students to compete at global level
- Fostering an ambiance where students can adopt the suitable moral, intellectual, emotional, and physical attributes to shine as the leaders of tomorrow’s society
- To strive to meet ever higher educational standard

#### [Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)](/p/ai-ml)

- **PEO1:** Graduates will be able to hone their problem-solving abilities and capacity to offer solutions to challenges that arise in the actual world.
- **PEO2:** Able to design and develop AI based solutions to real-world problems in a business, research, or social environment.
- **PEO3:** Graduates shall acquire and inculcate corporate culture, core attributes, and leadershipqualities as well as professional etiquette’s and lifelong learning..

#### [Program Specific Objectives (PSOs)](/p/ai-ml)

- **PSO1:** Ability to design and develop artificial intelligent based solutions by applying optimal algorithms to to solve real world issues.
- **PSO2:** Ability to apply suitable AI tools and techniques to offer solutions in the various domains of engineering

#### [Program Outcomes (POs)](/p/ai-ml)

**1 Engineering knowledge:** Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

**2\. Problem analysis:** Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.

**3\. Design/development of solutions:** Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.

**4\. Conduct investigations of complex problems:** Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.

**5\. Modern tool usage:** Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.

**6\. The engineer and society:** Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.

**7 .Environment and sustainability:** Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.

**8\. Ethics:** Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.

**9 .Individual and team work:** Function effectively as an individual, and as a member orleader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.

**10 .Communication:** Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.

**11\. Project management and finance:** Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

**12\. Life-long learning**: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

## CAREER GUIDANCE & PLACEMENT CELL INFRASTRUCTURE

ATME College of Engineering has a state-of-the-art infrastructure for its Career Guidance & Placement Cell. The infrastructure includes various facilities such as group discussion rooms of varying capacities, interview rooms, seminar hall, and many more.

![](/__l5e/assets-v1/cd2789cb-19db-417a-a06d-e5b768de2ebb/Discussion.jpg)**DISCUSSION ROOM**

The group discussion rooms are designed to accommodate different group sizes, ranging from small groups to larger groups. These rooms are equipped with the latest audio-visual technology, which enables students to conduct effective group discussions and debates. The rooms are also designed to provide a comfortable and conducive environment for students to engage in meaningful discussions.

**INTERVIEW ROOM**![](/__l5e/assets-v1/58e9ea8c-e3f8-45d3-9fa8-1a335c3a65c3/Interview.jpg)

The interview rooms are equipped with modern amenities and are designed to provide a professional and comfortable setting for students to attend job interviews. These rooms are equipped with high-quality audio-visual technology, which enables students to communicate effectively with potential employers. The interview rooms are also designed to provide students with a comfortable and stress-free environment, which enables them to perform at their best during interviews.

**![](/__l5e/assets-v1/a648e905-96c8-42bd-bdeb-119471d56699/Seminar-hall.jpg)SEMINAR HALL**

Seminar hall is a spacious and well-equipped facility that is designed to accommodate large gatherings. This facility is used for conducting seminars, workshops, and other training programs related to career guidance and placement. The seminar hall is equipped with modern audio-visual technology, which enables trainers to deliver interactive and engaging training sessions.

**RECEPTION**![](/__l5e/assets-v1/7b59f9d0-4b1e-4739-b02c-9ecfc5c1cee0/Reception.jpg)

In addition to these facilities, the Career Guidance & Placement Cell at ATME College of Engineering also has a computer lab, a library, and other resources that are designed to support students in their career development. The computer lab is equipped with the latest software and hardware, which enables students to acquire technical skills that are in demand in the job market. The library is stocked with books, journals, and other resources related to career guidance and placement, which enables students to stay updated with the latest trends and developments in their respective fields.

In essence, the infrastructure of the Career Guidance & Placement Cell at ATME College of Engineering is designed to provide students with a comprehensive and conducive environment for their career development. With these facilities, students are well-equipped to face the challenges of the job market and achieve their career goals.

career-guidance-placement-cell.title: Career Guidance & Placement Cell
career-guidance-placement-cell.description: ATME College of Engineering has a dedicated Career Guidance and Placement Cell (CGPC) that assists students in making informed career choices after completing
career-guidance-placement-cell.markdown:
[Skip to content](/p/career-guidance-placement-cell) [![ATME College of Engineering](/__l5e/assets-v1/4519b204-1c5c-4570-ad02-6e238e674849/ATME-Final-logo-copy.png)](/p/) ![](/__l5e/assets-v1/859bacc9-3515-4a7d-a555-17a0b4c37c8e/Photos-1800-X-600-05.jpg) ## Career Guidance and Placement Cell ATME College of Engineering has a dedicated Career Guidance and Placement Cell (CGPC) that assists students in making informed career choices after completing their engineering education. The CGPC provides facilitation and encouragement to students in the areas of placement, higher education, entrepreneurship, and civil services. The cell is committed to providing comprehensive guidance and support to help students explore various career options and choose the one that best suits their interests, skills, and goals. #### [Placement](/p/career-guidance-placement-cell) The CGPC at ATME College of Engineering works with various companies to bring placement opportunities for students. The cell conducts on-campus placement drives and off-campus drives for the benefit of students. The cell also provides pre-placement training to students, including mock interviews, group discussions, aptitude tests, and technical tests. The CGPC ensures that students are well prepared to face the selection process of companies. #### [Higher Education](/p/career-guidance-placement-cell) The CGPC at ATME College of Engineering also assists students who wish to pursue higher education after completing their engineering education. The cell provides guidance on the various courses available in India and abroad, the admission process, scholarship opportunities, and the eligibility criteria. The CGPC also conducts seminars and workshops to educate students about the different options available for higher education. #### [Entrepreneurship](/p/career-guidance-placement-cell) The CGPC at ATME College of Engineering recognizes the growing importance of entrepreneurship as a career choice. The cell provides guidance and support to students who are interested in starting their own businesses. The CGPC conducts workshops and training sessions on entrepreneurship, business planning, and funding options. The cell also invites successful entrepreneurs to share their experiences with students and motivate them to pursue entrepreneurship. #### [Civil Services](/p/career-guidance-placement-cell) The CGPC at ATME College of Engineering also provides guidance and support to students who aspire to join the civil services. The cell conducts seminars and workshops on the various civil service examinations, eligibility criteria, and the selection process. The CGPC also provides guidance on the preparation strategy, study material, and coaching institutes for civil service examinations. In conclusion, the Career Guidance and Placement Cell at ATME College of Engineering is committed to helping students make informed career choices. The cell provides guidance and support to students in the areas of placement, higher education, entrepreneurship, and civil services. The CGPC plays a vital role in shaping the careers of the students and preparing them for a successful future. ## TRAINING - ROAD MAP ATME College of Engineering has developed a comprehensive semester-wise road map for empowering students with a wide range of skills that are essential for their academic and professional success. The road map is designed to provide students with structured training in Communication skills, Soft skills, Aptitude, domain-specific technical training, and pre-placement training. | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | #### **Sl No** | #### **Semester** | #### **Skills and Training Offered** | | 1 | I, II | #### **Communication skills**
In the First and Second Semester, the focus is on **Communication skills**, where students are trained in the basics of English language proficiency, including grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation. They are also trained in effective communication skills, such as listening, speaking, and writing. This training helps students to develop their confidence and proficiency in using English as a medium of communication. | | 2 | III | #### **Soft Skills**
In the Third Semester, the focus shifts to **Soft Skills training**, where students are trained in skills such as teamwork, leadership, time management, problem-solving, and interpersonal communication. This training helps students to develop their overall personality and improve their employability skills. | | 3 | IV,V,VI | #### **Aptitude training**
In the Fourth, Fifth and Sixth semester, the focus is on Aptitude training, where students are trained in logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, and verbal reasoning. This training helps students to prepare for various competitive exams and placements. | | 4 | IV,V,VI,VII | #### **Domain-Specific Technical Training**
In the Fourth, Fifth, Sixth and Seventh Semester, the focus shifts to **Domain-Specific Technical Training**, where students are trained to acquire required skillsets in a particular career path. ATME is partnered with reputable companies and organizations to provide our students with the best possible training and certification opportunities. These programs are designed to provide in-depth knowledge and skills in specific domain, and often include hands-on training, practical applications, and industry-relevant projects. | | 5 | VII | #### **Pre-placement training**
In the Seventh semester, the focus is on **Pre-placement training**, where students are trained in skills such as resume building, interview skills, group discussions, and mock interviews. This training helps students to prepare for the placement process and improve their chances of getting placed in reputed organizations | To summarize, the semester-wise road map developed by ATME College of Engineering is a well-structured and comprehensive training program that empowers students with a wide range of skills that are essential for their academic and professional success. With this training, students are well-prepared to face the challenges of the rapidly evolving job market and achieve their career goals. ## Career Path

#### [Welcome to a World of Endless Possibilities - Career Paths in Engineering!](/p/career-path)

We take pride in preparing our students not just for academic success, but also for promising careers in the ever-evolving field of engineering. In the field of engineering, there are various specialized programs or domains that focus on specific areas of expertise within a broader engineering field. These specialized domains provide in-depth knowledge and training in a particular area, allowing engineers to develop expertise and pursue specific career paths within that field.

**We have carefully identified 3-4 exciting career paths in each branch of engineering and offer specialized domain-specific training and certification courses from 4th semester till 7th semester to help our students excel in their chosen career path.**

By pursuing a specific domain or concentration within an engineering program, engineers can gain specialized knowledge and skills that are highly relevant to their chosen career path. These specialized domains often have their own unique challenges, opportunities, and job prospects, and engineers can choose to specialize in a particular domain based on their interests, aptitude, and career goals.

In addition to the domain-specific training, we also focus on developing essential general skills such as communication, soft skills, aptitude, and pre-placement training. We believe that these skills are crucial for our students to become well-rounded professionals and excel in their careers.

Our goal is to ensure that our students are not only technically competent but also equipped with the necessary skills to thrive in today’s competitive job market. With our comprehensive curriculum that combines domain-specific training and general skills development, we are confident that our students will be well-prepared to face the challenges of the engineering industry and achieve success in their chosen career paths.

#### [Why is Identifying a Career Path is Important.](/p/career-path)

**Goal Clarity:** Identifying a career path helps engineers gain clarity on their long-term goals and aspirations. It provides a sense of direction and purpose, allowing engineers to make informed decisions about their professional development.

**Skill Development:** Different career paths require different skill sets. By identifying a career path, engineers can focus on acquiring the specific skills needed for their chosen field. This enables them to build expertise and specialize in a particular domain, making them more valuable to employers.

**Resource Allocation:** Engineers often invest significant time, effort, and resources in their education and professional development. Identifying a career path helps engineers make informed decisions about how to allocate their resources, such as time and money, to acquire the necessary skills and knowledge for their chosen field.

**Motivation and Engagement:** Having a clear career path provides engineers with motivation and a sense of purpose. It keeps them engaged in their work, as they have a clear vision of their career goals and are constantly working towards achieving them.

#### [Domain-Specific training and Self-Learning MOOCs courses for Career Paths.](/p/career-path)

**Domain Specific Training**

Domain-specific training is good options that can help in acquiring required skillsets in a particular career path. There are several specialized agencies, institutes, and organizations that offer domain-specific training programs in design engineering. These programs are designed to provide in-depth knowledge and skills in specific domain, and often include hands-on training, practical applications, and industry-relevant projects.

We are proud to partner with reputable companies and organizations to provide our students with the best possible training and certification opportunities. These collaborations enable our students to gain real-world exposure and hands-on experience, making them job-ready upon graduation.

## MOOC

Self-learning MOOCs are an effective way for engineers to gain domain-specific training, as they provide flexibility, convenience, and accessibility. Here’s why self-learning MOOCs are beneficial for engineers:

**Flexibility:** MOOCs offer flexibility in terms of learning pace and schedule, allowing engineers to learn at their own convenience. They can access course materials and assignments online, which enables them to balance their learning with their professional commitments.

**Accessibility:** MOOCs provide access to a wide range of courses, covering diverse engineering domains and topics. Engineers can choose from a variety of courses that align with their career path and interests, regardless of their location or background.

**Quality Content:** MOOCs often feature content created by industry experts and leading universities, ensuring the quality and relevance of the course material. Engineers can learn from the best and stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies.

**Cost-Effective:** MOOCs are often more cost-effective compared to traditional classroom-based training. Engineers can access high-quality course material at a fraction of the cost of traditional education, making it a cost-effective option for domain-specific training.

**Lifelong Learning:** Self-learning MOOCs promote a culture of lifelong learning among engineers. They can continuously update their skills and knowledge by enrolling in relevant courses throughout their career, helping them stay competitive in the job market.

In today’s competitive engineering landscape, identifying a career path and acquiring domain-specific training are essential for professional success. Self-learning MOOCs provide a flexible, accessible, and cost-effective way for engineers to acquire domain-specific skills and knowledge. By leveraging MOOCs, engineers can stay ahead in their careers, excel in their chosen field, and remain lifelong learners. So, whether you’re a budding engineer or an experienced professional, take the time to identify your career path and explore the wide array of self-learning MOOCs available to enhance your skills and propel your career forward.
